issues.description: Hydration error: progress bar width mismatches between server ('width:5%') and client ('width:15%'). This causes full root hydration failure and multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' errors.
issues.element: Progress bar div with inline style width
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, the progress bar width is computed dynamically (likely based on currentQuestion state or Math.random()), producing different values on server vs client. Server renders 5% but client hydrates to 15%.

issues.description: Progress counter shows 'Question 1 of 3' but this is step-3 of the design flow. The question counter may be resetting to 1 on each render due to state initialization mismatch during hydration.
issues.root_cause: State initialized to 1 on both server and client but hydration failure causes client re-render resetting to initial state, or the progress width is derived from question index causing the mismatch.

issues.description: No room images visible despite expected behavior describing 'Two room images side by side for preference selection'. The current question is text-only which may be acceptable for question 1.
issues.root_cause: Current question type is text-options rather than image comparison. May be correct for Q1 of 3.

fixes.reason: Ensure consistent integer percentage calculation between server and client to prevent hydration mismatch.
Ensure client directive is present and hooks are imported for suppressing hydration issues.
Defer dynamic rendering until after mount to prevent server/client width mismatch on the progress bar.
